doc: OUTSIDE THE CONTRACT, pinned so that nobody generalizes it silently: _sample is defined for SQUARE fields (every tile, size field and map of tiles.py is square). m = shape[0] is used for BOTH axes, so on a 5x9 field (value row * 9 + col) the column is trunc(x * 5) % 5 and columns 5 to 8 are never read. A port that scales the column by shape[1] differs here and nowhere else. Exact.
